_about: Documents of sanandreascontrol.eu, in reading order. file = Markdown in docs/ (max ~60 000 characters each). category groups them in the library. Images: ![caption](img/<file>) = avi_web/web/img/<file> (jpg / png as files, svg inlined by the server). Links to other documents: [text](doc:<id>) or [text](doc:<id>#<heading-id>).

documents.title: Letter of Agreement
documents.summary: Where, when and at what level the units hand aircraft over to each other.

documents.title: Operations Manual 1 - General
documents.summary: Units, rights, airspace, who controls an aircraft, separation, levels, alerts and pay.

documents.title: Operations Manual 2 - Aerodrome control
documents.summary: Tower: runways, IFR clearance, pushback, taxi, take-off, landing, vacating, go-around.

documents.title: Operations Manual 3 - Approach control
documents.summary: Approach: STARs, descent, the final, cleared approach, vectoring, departures. STAR entry level table.

documents.title: Operations Manual 4 - Area control
documents.summary: San Andreas Control: centre sectors and positions, overflights, arrivals, departures, levels.

documents.title: Airspace and navigation
documents.summary: Airspace structure, navigation points and their names, SID / STAR / go-around procedures.

documents.title: ATC software manual
documents.summary: The controller software: login, the scope, labels, the command menu, the heading picker, lists.
